name: Lovable
intro: Lovable went from its first dollar to a $500M annualized run rate in roughly 19 months — the fastest revenue ramp on record in software. Every reported ARR, MRR, funding and headcount number is collected below, each traced back to a public source.

modelParagraphs: Lovable monetizes with a tiered subscription that starts around $20/month and runs to roughly $100/month, plus custom enterprise agreements. On top of the plan sits credit-based usage: a simple game might burn about $1 of credits, a complex app $50 or more. The free tier ships with hosting, which turns every abandoned side project into a future upgrade.

Subscriptions carry the bulk of revenue — enough that in June 2025 Lovable deliberately wrote off $1.5M of ARR in a single day by folding its Team tier into the cheaper Pro plan. Enterprise arrived later, with Klarna and HubSpot among the named logos.
revenueMix: AI generation billed by consumption, so revenue tracks app complexity.
Free builds and hosting seed a land-and-expand upgrade path.
Named customers include Klarna and HubSpot.

faqs.a: Lovable said it passed $500 million in annualized revenue run rate on June 9, 2026, up from $400 million in February 2026 and $100 million in July 2025. That implies roughly $41.7 million of monthly recurring revenue.

faqs.q: How Fast Did Lovable Reach $100M ARR?
faqs.a: Eight months after its public launch in November 2024 — the fastest software company on record to that milestone, ahead of previously reported record-holders such as Cursor and Wiz.

faqs.q: What Does a Lovable Subscription Actually Include?
faqs.a: Tiered plans from around $20/month up to about $100/month, plus custom enterprise agreements, with usage-based credits for AI generation on top. A free tier with hosting seeds the land-and-expand motion into paid teams.

faqs.q: What Is Lovable's Valuation and How Much Has It Raised?
faqs.a: A $330 million Series B in December 2025 led by CapitalG and Menlo Ventures' Anthology fund valued Lovable at $6.6 billion. That followed a $200 million Series A led by Accel at $1.8 billion in July 2025.

faqs.q: How Many People Work at Lovable?
faqs.a: About 146 employees as of February 2026, which works out to roughly $2.77 million of ARR per employee — among the highest ratios ever reported in software.
